definitions.gloss: water-based paint; paint thinned with water
definitions.explanation: Paint that uses water as its solvent, so it can be thinned and cleaned up with water. Contrasts with oil-based paint.

examples.japanese: {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}で{絵|え}を{描|か}く。
examples.english: Paint a picture with water-based paint.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}には{水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}のほうが{安全|あんぜん}だ。
examples.english: Water-based paint is safer for children.

examples.japanese: {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}は{乾|かわ}くのが{速|はや}く、{筆|ふで}を{水|みず}で{洗|あら}うだけで{片付|かたづ}けられる。
examples.english: Water-based paint dries quickly, and you can clean up just by washing the brushes with water.

notes:
Composed of {水性|すいせい} (water-based) + {絵具|えのぐ} (paint, pigment). Common in schools and for hobby use because it is easy to handle and clean up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}で{描|か}く: to paint with water-based paint
- {水性|すいせい}{絵具|えのぐ}を{溶|と}く: to thin water-based paint (with water)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {油性|ゆせい}{絵具|えのぐ}: oil paint — uses oil as solvent, slower to dry, harder to clean up
- {水彩|すいさい}{絵具|えのぐ}: watercolor paint — a specific type of water-based paint for transparent washes
